verdict.rationale: Rainforest's buy-rate, interchange-plus model lets the platform fully control what it bills merchants, so the markup over cost becomes platform revenue ([rainforest-docs-12], [rainforest-docs-13]). Per-merchant Billing Profiles set each seller's fees and rates ([rainforest-docs-36]), and amount splits configured on payins provide a per-transaction fee mechanism ([rainforest-docs-6], [rainforest-docs-28]). missing for 10: explicit evidence of reporting that separates platform payments revenue from processing costs (only a generic reporting component is mentioned in [rainforest-docs-15]), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
